chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Abi 'Ali, from al-Husayn ibn Yasar al-Wasiti, who said:

I asked Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), 'Should I go to the Ziyarah of the grave of Abi al-Hasan (peace be upon him) in Baghdad?' He replied, 'If you must, then perform the Ziyarah from behind the covers.'

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abi al-Hasan, referring to Imam Musa al-Kazim (a.s.)
key_terms.الْحِجَابِ: The veil or partition, indicating a covered or semi-private location for the grave
key_terms.بِغْدَادَ: Baghdad, the city where the grave is located

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method for visiting the grave of Imam al-Kazim in Baghdad according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the practical flexibility in Shia devotional practice, where physical proximity is secondary to spiritual reverence and modesty (haya). The instruction to visit 'from behind the veil' reflects the historical context of the Imam's shrine in Baghdad, where architectural partitions or crowds might obscure direct view, emphasizing that the sanctity of the visit lies in the intention and respect shown rather than mere visual contact.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Abī ‘Ali, from Ḥusain ibn Yasār Al-Wāsiťi, who said:
I asked Imam Riďā (a.s.), “Should I go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Abil Ḥasan (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) in Baghdad?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “If you must, then perform the Ziyārah from behind the covers.”
